newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-INDIA GDRS FOLLOW WEAK BOMBAY IN LONDON.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-INDIA GDRS FOLLOW WEAK BOMBAY IN LONDON.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts fell back in London on Friday following the bearish lead from Bombay where profit-taking dominated for the third consecutive session.
"The market has had a good run and we are taking a bit of a breather. But we are not seeing big selling -- it's mainly market-makers marking down prices," said one London dealer.
The HSBC James Capel India GDR index JCEAI fell 1.55 points, or 1.76 percent, to 86.55, a premium of 20.14 percent to the local market.
The Cazenove Indian GDR index, which measures changes from midday to midday, was down 2.28 points at 97.43 as Bombay's benchmark 30-share index gave up 49.52 points to 4,397.54.
London traders said Friday features included Tata Engineering and Locomotive, down 37 cents at 12.50/13.50, and Indian Hotels, off 66 at 19.75/20.75.
The Capel Taiwanese and Korean GDR indices were not immediately available.
